_doc: Hand labels by eye on 1920x1080 frames (frames/eval/<clip>__<clip-second>.png). robots = centre points of robots I am sure of; unsure = things that might be a robot (detections there count neither way). Clip second s = match second s-15 (approx, see clip json). Robots fully hidden behind towers or people are not labelled, so recall is over VISIBLE robots.
